items.text: The Eagles will play their first game on Sunday without Jalen Hurts; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Blood clot in calf; first game missed confirmed on Insiders.
items.implication: QB downgrade to McKee; healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) still viable but efficiency risk.
items.opportunity: Pass volume may rise; thin RB room (Pierce 4th-string) limits checkdowns.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers (hamstring).
items.why: Official team ruling confirmed by Schefter; hamstring injury.
items.implication: Major RB downgrade; PHI backfield to Dameon Pierce and others; pass-catchers elevated with McKee starting.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and early-down work shifts to remaining RBs; DeVonta Smith/Goedert/Wicks volume up.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury; another game without him.
items.why: Missed all practice; ankle sprain; Huntley starts again.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Flowers still WR2-ish, Andrews more volatile.
items.opportunity: Huntley game script may boost short targets; reverse prior Lamar beneficiaries if any stale.

items.text: Jets once again ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs. Patriots.
items.why: Third straight miss; DNP all week on quad.
items.implication: Braelon Allen full load again; Hall week-to-week for W7.
items.opportunity: Allen early-down/goal-line share locked; Jets RB handcuff value elevated short-term.

items.text: AJ Brown (ankle) questionable and unclear; practiced limited all week earlier than expected.
items.why: Levitan: unclear status; Rapoport notes limited practice all week.
items.implication: Game-time risk; if OUT, NE WR depth thins further.
items.opportunity: Monitor for active; high upside if clears.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) questionable and unclear despite practice this week; doubt high-ankle given activity.
items.why: Levitan notes unclear; practiced but odd progression from high-ankle reports.
items.implication: NE RB committee risk; monitor for role if active.
items.opportunity: If OUT, other NE RBs (Stevenson etc) expand; if IN, committee.

items.text: Tyler Warren (groin) Friday addition as questionable; injury occurred in individual drills.
items.why: Sudden Friday Q after visible drill injury; Schefter confirmed add.
items.implication: IND TE risk; monitor for snap share drop if limited.
items.opportunity: If OUT, other IND pass-catchers (Pittman/Downs/Pierce) gain routes.

items.text: PIT without WRs Michael Pittman, Roman Wilson, Ben Skowronek; expect heavy 2-WR sets with DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard. Metcalf Q (illness) but more probable.
items.why: Depth chart thinned; Metcalf probable despite illness Q.
items.implication: Metcalf target/route monopoly in 2-WR; high floor/ceiling.
items.opportunity: Snap share and red-zone elevated; Bernard secondary.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed IN for Sunday; returns after hamstring absence, no designation.
items.why: Removed from report; self-reported good; plays with McKee.
items.implication: WR2/3 with healthy top pass-catchers despite Hurts/Barkley OUT.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets rebound; reverse any Wicks over-ownership.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday’s game; cleared/IN.
items.why: No designation after prior uncertainty; ETR lists IN.
items.implication: Full snap/route share expected vs KC; upgrade from Q risk.
items.opportunity: Primary target share locked with other Chargers injuries.

items.text: Tanner McKee will have PHI's 4th-string RB (Dameon Pierce) but top-4 pass-catchers healthy: DeVonta, Goedert, Wicks, Lemon.
items.why: Despite Hurts/Barkley OUT and thin RB, healthy WR/TE corps with McKee.
items.implication: Pass-catchers retain startable value; volume opportunity vs CAR.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets concentrated; reverse stale RB beneficiaries.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4); Washington defense buffet for pass-catchers.
items.why: Soft matchup vs Commanders pass defense; usage bankable.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high target upside.
items.opportunity: Red-zone and volume vs weak secondary.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage; Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and leaky run D; also Javonte Williams @GB (RB8) goal-line role, Rhamondre vs NYJ (RB9) volume.
items.why: London usage reliable; RBs get volume + favorable run defenses/goal-line.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) tough matchup; Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34); Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18); also Dobbins, Nix, Herbert for matchup/QB issues.
items.why: Ugly matchups, shaky QB situations, low volume lately.
